constraint_addition:
# Target actual observed synchronous DDR UI CE/reset endpoints, which Fmax
# omits. This8ns physical budget is stricter than the original10ns clock;
# it never waives a control path or changes a clock or minimum-delay check.
set_max_delay 8.000 -from [get_clocks {ddr_ui100}] -to [get_pins {u_tf_audio/u_path/u_dma/read_buf*/CE u_tf_audio/u_path/u_dma/read_buf*/RESET u_tf_audio/u_path/u_dma/emit_index*/CE u_tf_audio/u_path/u_dma/emit_index*/RESET u_tf_audio/u_path/u_dma/emit_bytes_left*/CE u_video/u_bist/failed*/CE u_video/u_bist/error_count*/CE u_video/u_arbiter/u_*_slot/queued_data*/RESET u_video/u_arbiter/u_*_slot/queued_data*/CE}]
constraint_source: Local official SUG940-2.0.4E section5.4.2; get_clocks/get_pins start/end selectors, max-delay changes setup/recovery only
